recipes.name: Chocolate Banana Buckwheat Porridge
ingredients: ½ Tbsp mini dark chocolate chips
instructions: Add the buckwheat and milk to a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and cook covered with a lid for 15 minutes, stirring often.
When cooked, add the mashed banana, cocoa powder, tahini, maple syrup, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt. Stir until heated through.
Remove from the heat and cover with a lid. Let sit for 5 minutes. This helps to soften the grain further.
Serve, add toppings as desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If using raw buckwheats, toast them first on a dry skillet over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes until golden, stirring throughout. † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk/yogurt that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Store in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
